changes: Search no longer lists chats anywhere: no matching chats section over the results, no chats row on the search page, and Continue watching rows show the video's own year, quality and length instead of a chat name
Reopening the app settles on its cached Home under the loading mark until the first screen is ready, and the cached Home counts as settled at once, with freshness arriving behind it

Copies, versions, series and seasons fill faster: the chats are asked together instead of one waiting on another, and the player now runs the same title fill as the title page, so copies keep arriving while a video plays
Search results stand still while they arrive: rows no longer slide about as pages land, and placement settles once the search does
Cast pages find their titles: credits are checked against everything the app already holds and then asked across the chats you browse, and a long filmography no longer spends many minutes asking
Embedded subtitle translation asks in batches and retries once when the service is busy, so a busy moment no longer leaves a line in its original language for good
notes: Search without chats, a Home that is ready on open, faster copies and seasons everywhere, and subtitle translation that keeps asking.
